entries.title: The key shown after a click stays longer and fades
entries.body: After you click a button that has a keyboard shortcut, the shortcut at the bottom of the window now stays for about five seconds, and it fades in and out instead of appearing and vanishing at once. Pressing a key or clicking elsewhere still takes it away at once.
entries.noPicture: The reminder looks the same at rest; it only stays longer and fades, which a still picture cannot show.
